display.purpose: The loan amount figure — the single number this step exists to let the customer set.

body.purpose: Repayment estimate line and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Field labels, pill and button text.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button and slider thumb at rest — the only elements allowed a shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition — pills, switch thumb, button hover, amount pulse.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen (e.g. Save & Continue).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ffb833 0%, #e09b1e 100%); color: #241a05; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.98rem; border: none; padding: 15px 30px; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -8px rgba(255,184,51,0.35); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 32px -8px rgba(255,184,51,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb833; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); color: #a8a6c0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms, color 180ms, background 180ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #a8a6c0; color: #f4f3f7; background: #14151f; }

components.name: Selection Pill
components.description: Single-select chip used for purpose and term choice groups.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: #14151f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #a8a6c0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.88rem; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms, background 160ms, color 160ms, transform 120ms; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); color: #f4f3f7; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pill[aria-checked='true'] { background: #ffb833; border-color: #ffb833; color: #241a05; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb833; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Amount Slider
components.description: The signature control — sets the loan amount, drives the live amount figure and repayment estimate.
components.html: <input type="range" class="ds-slider" min="5000" max="300000" step="1000" value="50000" style="--fill: 15%">
components.css: .ds-slider { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #ffb833 0%, #ffb833 var(--fill,15%), #262838 var(--fill,15%), #262838 100%); outline: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffb833; border: 4px solid #0b0c14; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px rgba(255,184,51,0.35), 0 0 0 1px #e09b1e; cursor: grab; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Two-option exclusive switch (e.g. Just me / Me + someone else). Options must stay equal-width — the sliding thumb is a 50%-width absolute element.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: min(100%, 420px); background: #14151f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px; gap: 4px; } .ds-switch-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc(50% - 4px); background: #ffb833; border-radius: 999px; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); z-index: 0; } .ds-switch[data-active='2'] .ds-switch-thumb { transform: translateX(100%); } .ds-switch-opt { position: relative; z-index: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: #a8a6c0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.88rem; padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 999px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-switch-opt.is-active { color: #241a05; }

narrative.overview: A digital bank's after-hours trading floor, not a brochure: near-black ink surfaces, one precise gold signal, and numbers that mean something the instant they change. Where DigiBank's original portal (TCS Blue/Yellow, light chrome, card grids) reads as a form to fill in, Signal Gold reads as a live instrument the customer is operating — closer to Revolut's dark ticker energy and Monzo's confident single-accent discipline than to Apple's deliberately quiet neutrality, which this brief explicitly rejected as too bland for a product whose whole point is "how much money, on what terms." Gold was chosen over the more expected neo-bank accents (electric purple, hot coral, mint-teal) because it's load-bearing: it reads as value in a lending product, not just as a brand color, and it lets DigiBank retire its literal blue/yellow palette while still rhyming with "yellow = DigiBank" at a conceptual level.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tinted base (never pure black or neutral gray) with a single saturated gold signal
No boxed cards anywhere — pills, a slider, and a segmented switch carry the interface instead
Every large numeral on screen is a real, live-computed value, never a decorative stat
Space Grotesk for anything the eye should land on first; Inter for everything read in sequence

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only color that means "act here" or "this is chosen." The moment a second saturated color is used for selection or emphasis in the same control group, the system has lost its own discipline.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow/kicker label ever sits above a heading in this system. The headline carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow just for existing. A surface earns a shadow only by being gold.

dos: Do use Signal Gold for exactly one job per control group: the primary action, or the selected state.
Do tint every secondary/tertiary text color from the background's violet undertone — never a plain neutral gray.
Do keep large numerals in Space Grotesk with tabular-nums so digits don't jitter as they change.
Do keep surfaces in this world effectively card-less unless a genuinely new content type requires a bounded container.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent competing with Signal Gold for attention. Ledger Mint and Alert Coral are feedback-only.
Don't reach for a drop shadow on a non-gold surface. Depth is the three ink tiers, not box-shadow.
Don't fall back to Inter, or any system sans, as the display voice for headings or large numerals.
Don't revive the retired DigiBank Blue (#003F79) or Yellow (#F5A200) inside this direction.
